module: Editor API module intended to manage navigation meshes (NavMesh), off-mesh links and covers for AI. In 0.40.5 it is an empty shell: all the functions are `--TODO` with no body. `initialize` attaches them to the `editor` object (editor.createNavMesh, etc.).
notes: All the functions installed on `editor` do nothing and return nil (body = TODO).
The `navMeshInfo`, `linkInfo`, `coverInfo` parameters have no structure defined in the code.

initialize.desc: Remembers the editor instance and installs the nine navmesh/cover/offmeshlink functions on it (not implemented).

editorInstance.desc: `editor` object on which to place the functions

editor.desc: Functions added to the `editor` object by `initialize`. All are empty stubs (TODO).

navMeshObjectId.desc: navmesh object id (inferred from the name)

createOffMeshLink.desc: Stub: should create an off-mesh link.

deleteOffMeshLink.desc: Stub: should delete an off-mesh link.

coverObjectId.desc: cover object id (inferred from the name)

getCovers.desc: Stub: should list the covers of a navmesh.

getOffMeshLinks.desc: Stub: should list the off-mesh links.
